convertibility_reason: Uses iCustom for ColorZerolagTriX indicator and includes TradeAlgorithms.mqh for trading logic (BuyPositionOpen, SellPositionOpen, etc.). Custom indicator with 5 factor-weighted TriX components requires recreation in Python.

derived_values.name: min_rates_total - minimum bars for indicator warmup

other_exits: Signal-based close: buy close triggered when buffer0 crosses below buffer1 (opposite crossover), sell close triggered when buffer0 crosses above buffer1, controlled by BuyPosClose/SellPosClose input flags

position_sizing.conditional_logic: MMMode enum (LOT vs MARGIN) determines whether MM value is interpreted as fixed lots or as fraction of deposit margin

custom_logic_notes: The ColorZerolagTriX is a zero-lag weighted composite of 5 TriX indicators with factors (0.05, 0.10, 0.16, 0.26, 0.43) summing to 1.0. Signal detection uses SignalBar=1 (previous bar) for crossover detection comparing bar[1] vs bar[0] of the indicator buffers. Entry signals are gated by BuyPosOpen/SellPosOpen boolean inputs. Exit-on-reverse is gated by BuyPosClose/SellPosClose boolean inputs. The GlobalVariableDel_ and LoadHistory calls from TradeAlgorithms.mqh handle global variable cleanup and history loading. The crossover logic: for long, Osc1[1]>Osc2[1] (established uptrend) AND Osc1[0]<Osc2[0] (current crossover up); for short, Osc1[1]<Osc2[1] (established downtrend) AND Osc1[0]>Osc2[0] (current crossover down).
python_conversion_notes: Must recreate the ColorZerolagTriX custom indicator in Python. It is a weighted sum of 5 TriX indicators: composite = Factor1*TriX1 + Factor2*TriX2 + Factor3*TriX3 + Factor4*TriX4 + Factor5*TriX5. Each TriX is a triple-smoothed EMA rate-of-change. The smoothing parameter (15) is applied to the final composite. Two buffers are produced (fast/slow lines, likely the composite and its signal line). The TradeAlgorithms.mqh functions (BuyPositionOpen, SellPositionOpen, BuyPositionClose, SellPositionClose, GlobalVariableDel_, LoadHistory, CIsNewBar) need Python equivalents. Position sizing supports LOT mode (fixed lots) and MARGIN mode (fraction of free margin). SL/TP are in points (1000 and 2000 respectively) - may need digit-adjustment for 5-digit brokers. Signal logic compares indicator values at bar[SignalBar] and bar[SignalBar+1] to detect crossovers.
